Maya leans in, voice low. "Here's what we figured out about Hushpuppy. Wound the lead. Wound the lead and the pack breaks. Hit the FIRST wolf — the one that came in first — and the coordination dies. They fear fire, but breaking the lead is free."

🔥 The fire settles. Diana has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Hushpuppy — I put it down today." "No telegraph you can hear. Watch the birds — when they go quiet, the pack is already moving." "The pack circles — nips from the edge, never committing." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Dmitri says quietly "Did it look at you? Before?" Akulyna breathes "So it bleeds." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"
